description.value: Invermere Hostel is a year-round, 24-hour hostel a short walk from Windermere Lake, James Chabot Beach, and the Columbia River in Invermere, BC. It offers a range of room types from four-person dorms to private queen rooms, making it a flexible option for budget-minded touring cyclists passing through the Columbia Valley. The hostel sits near the town centre and is a stop on the Invermere/Panorama free winter shuttle route.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is clearly current (references July 2025 phone maintenance and 2024/2025 Panorama ski season), so it is used as the primary evidence source. Wi-Fi is explicitly confirmed by the website ('Wireless Internet available throughout the entire property at no extra cost'). No bike-specific amenities (storage, tools, wash, e-bike charging) are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, so all bike-related criteria are null. The OSM phone number (+1-778-776-1744) is corroborated by the website, which also lists a toll-free number (+1 866 222 0325) not recorded in OSM.
concerns: Website also lists a toll-free number (+1 866 222 0325) not recorded in OSM; the OSM number (+1-778-776-1744) is confirmed as one of two valid numbers.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The hostel is clearly operational and well-located for touring cyclists in the Columbia Valley, but neither secure bike storage nor staff bike procedure could be confirmed from the website — direct contact is needed to verify the key required criteria before listing.

Nearby evening food.detail: Rocky River Grill Station Pub listed in the hostel's own Local Info navigation menu

Wi-Fi.detail: Wireless Internet available throughout the entire property at no extra cost; most rooms also have wired Ethernet connections

wow_evidence: year-round, 24-hour hostel a short walk from Windermere Lake, James Chabot Beach
